# ai-prompt-optimizer-api
Cloudflare Workers MCP server: ai-prompt-optimizer. REST + MCP (JSON-RPC 2.0). Live: api.lazy-mac.com/ai-prompt-optimizer

toolsPreview.name: optimize_prompt
toolsPreview.description: Optimize a prompt by removing filler words, compressing verbosity, and returning token savings.

toolsPreview.name: analyze_prompt
toolsPreview.description: Analyze a prompt for clarity score, filler patterns, ambiguity, and improvement suggestions.

toolsPreview.name: estimate_tokens
toolsPreview.description: Estimate token count of a prompt or batch of texts.

toolsPreview.name: compare_prompts
toolsPreview.description: Compare two prompts. Returns winner by clarity score and token delta.
